tips: Ring your Core with walls: each of the 8 neighbors cuts damage to it, up to 80% off.
Towers count double for Core cover and ward your whole fort by 10 percent each.
Cannons boost your siege damage by 15 percent each: build one before the horns.
Your Core cannot move, sell, or upgrade: defend it, it always takes hits.
An empty fort cannot hide: the enemy Core is attackable from the first horn.
Killing the enemy Core pays 60 and ends the round at once: focus fire it.
A healthy Core pays half its health as authority at round end: repair by defending.
Shots always hit the tapped cell: no redirection, no lucky misses.
Fire arrows cool down fast: use them to finish off cracked walls.
Teardown refunds half your bricks, but never your Core: rebuild smarter.
A level-2 tower has double health and still wards: upgrade before the siege.
Spread cover, not just walls: two towers beside the Core equal four walls.
Focus fire with your team: one destroyed Core beats three dented walls.
Destroyed structures pay a bonus: always finish what you start.
